findings.body: In `public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/shardQuerySplitting.ts` at line 281, the function `groupHasPendingRequests` mutates the `cycle` property of the group by setting it to `nextCycle`. This side effect during a predicate check is unexpected and can lead to confusing behavior or bugs in the iteration logic that relies on this function. Predicate functions should not mutate their inputs.
findings.suggestion: Refactor `groupHasPendingRequests` to avoid mutating `group.cycle`. Instead, update `cycle` explicitly in the calling code after the check.
findings.title: Predicate function `groupHasPendingRequests` mutates input group cycle property

findings.body: In `public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/querySplitting.ts` at lines 296-299, the `runSplitQuery` function now applies template variable interpolation to each query target before further processing. This is a behavior change that could affect downstream consumers expecting raw queries. However, the tests added verify this behavior and it aligns with the intended functionality to interpolate variables before splitting queries.
findings.title: `runSplitQuery` now applies template variables to queries before splitting

findings.body: In `public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/shardQuerySplitting.ts` at lines 48-55, the `runShardSplitQuery` function was changed to apply template variables to queries before passing them to `splitQueriesByStreamShard`. This aligns with the change in `runSplitQuery` and is consistent. The tests verify that `applyTemplateVariables` is called the expected number of times. This change is safe and improves consistency.
findings.title: `runShardSplitQuery` applies template variables to queries before splitting

findings.body: In `public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/shardQuerySplitting.ts` at lines 68-210, the `runNextRequest` function calls `runSplitQuery` with options `{ skipPartialUpdates: true, disableRetry: true }`. This disables retry and partial updates for the inner split queries. This is a deliberate design choice to avoid nested retries and partial updates, which is reasonable. The tests confirm this behavior. No issues found here.
findings.title: Inner calls to `runSplitQuery` disable retry and partial updates as intended

models.summary: The change introduces interpolation of template variables before query splitting in both `runSplitQuery` and `runShardSplitQuery`, improving consistency and correctness. Tests were added to verify this behavior. The main concern is a medium-severity issue where a predicate function mutates its input, which should be refactored to avoid side effects. Other changes are low severity and align with intended functionality.
